page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top. Two columns of short entries in the body, with a continuation of the first column's last entry running across the top, then a centred heading (ABACUS Magnitudinis.) and a sub-heading (COGNATA.), then two parallel columns of entries, and a catchword "Uni-" at the lower right.

main_text.p:
Mendacium, falsum. utilitate.
Vile. Damnum.
Abjectum. Superfluitas.
Jactura rerum, sine
main_text.head: ABACUS Magnitudinis.
COGNATA.

page.notes: The entries are set in two columns; the pairing of lines across columns is approximate in this transcription. The head "ABACUS Magnitudinis." is a running heading inside the page. Some words at the column edges are partly obscured by staining and show-through.
